title: Critical care (outpatient)
description: Critical care is specialized medical treatment for patients with severe, life-threatening conditions. Your medical team provides continuous monitoring and intensive management in a dedicated critical care setting. During this treatment, you'll receive comprehensive support including respiratory assistance, medication infusions, and frequent vital sign monitoring. Your care is overseen by specially trained critical care physicians and nurses. This intensive approach allows your medical team to respond immediately to any changes in your condition. Critical care may be used for various emergencies, from severe infections to major organ dysfunction. The goal is to stabilize you and manage complications while your underlying condition is treated. Your family will be kept informed about your progress and involved in care decisions when possible.

contents.description: Critical care, evaluation, and management; 30 - 74 minutes
